evals.prompt: Is research on neuromorphic computing heating up or has the publication trend flattened out? I want the yearly paper counts and citation velocity, not a vibe.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: States the index, query string and year window used; Buckets papers by publication year and reads the curve shape; Reports citation velocity and whether it is accelerating, steady or decelerating; Calls a research-front or maturing verdict and names what would flip it.
expectations: States the index, query string and year window used
Buckets papers by publication year and reads the curve shape
Reports citation velocity and whether it is accelerating, steady or decelerating
Calls a research-front or maturing verdict and names what would flip it

evals.prompt: Three groups keep publishing on this topic and everyone calls it an exploding field. How much academic attention is it really getting, and is the growth faster than science as a whole?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Counts distinct authors and institutions to judge whether the front is broad or nascent; Compares the growth rate against the roughly 8-9% per year global literature baseline; Reports low confidence when the paper count is small.
expectations: Counts distinct authors and institutions to judge whether the front is broad or nascent
Compares the growth rate against the roughly 8-9% per year global literature baseline
Reports low confidence when the paper count is small

evals.prompt: Fit an S-curve to the yearly paper counts for solid-state electrolyte research and tell me which phase the literature is in.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Fits a logistic curve and reports K, growth rate, midpoint and R-squared; Classifies the phase as emergent, growth or mature from the fraction of capacity reached; Treats a poor fit as a finding rather than smoothing it over.
expectations: Fits a logistic curve and reports K, growth rate, midpoint and R-squared
Classifies the phase as emergent, growth or mature from the fraction of capacity reached
Treats a poor fit as a finding rather than smoothing it over

evals.prompt: What does the evidence actually say about whether these interventions work? I need a reproducible review with inclusion and exclusion criteria and a screening audit trail.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Follows a PRISMA-style identification, screening, eligibility and inclusion process; Synthesises findings rather than counting publications per year.
expectations: Follows a PRISMA-style identification, screening, eligibility and inclusion process
Synthesises findings rather than counting publications per year

evals.prompt: Is this technology overhyped by the press right now, and how many years until it settles into the plateau of productivity?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Places the technology on a maturity-of-expectations curve from press, funding and deployment indicators; Does not produce a bibliometric S-curve fit.
expectations: Places the technology on a maturity-of-expectations curve from press, funding and deployment indicators
Does not produce a bibliometric S-curve fit
